title: Odyssey Systems data-management platforms

tellings.quote: some of the underlying like tech platforms that were being used just in terms of like data management um were Odyssey Systems,

plain: Jordan Jose, who says he was taken into a secret UFO programme as a child, says that around 2008 to 2010 the programme's data was handled on technology platforms run by firms called Odyssey Systems and MITRE. He tells Michels this from what he says he saw himself. If true, it would name the private contractors behind the programme's record-keeping.
